name: Dry run: fake reviewers (real bugs 60%, decoys 85%)

design.prior: cross-fitted: each repository's units use priors fitted on the other repositories

variants.name: pooled
variants.label: Pooled blind-rate prior (empirical Bayes from other repositories)

notes: DRY RUN: fake reviewers, no models. Checks the pipeline and the math only.
Actual hidden counts only the k known bugs; fixed functions may hide others, so actual is a lower bound.
Decoys were test-validated on the fixed version of each function.
Each bug appears in up to 4 units; confidence intervals resample whole repositories.
